posts.text:
Kash Patel would not have made it through the first stage (of many) of FBI screening. He knows it, and it makes him
mad. Remember that authoritarians hire mediocre doofuses previsely because it ensures their loyalty: there is no other universe where these guys would ever have their jobs
posts.summary: Criticizes Kash Patel as unqualified and selected for loyalty over competence
